verdict.rationale: DOR documents a mail rail for business license applications: send the Business License Application, any additional forms, and payment to the address printed on the form, with up to six weeks of processing. It also publishes a 24/7 automated phone line (360-705-6705) on its tax-returns help page. However, the excise/B&O return must be filed through MyDOR, and the mailing address is only referenced indirectly via the form. Missing for 10: mailing address published on the page itself, any fax number, a paper or mail fallback for excise tax returns, and independent confirmation that the fallbacks work.
